'''Johannes Boersma''' (5 December 1937 [[Marrum]] – 29 November 2004 [[Eindhoven]]) was a Dutch mathematician who specialized in [[mathematical analysis]]. His PhD advisor at the [[University of Groningen]] was [[Adriaan Isak van de Vooren]].

==Selected publications==
* {{cite journal | last1= Boersma | first1= J. | last2= Dempsey | first2= J.P. | title= On the evaluation of Legendre's chi-function | jstor= 2152987 | journal= Mathematics of Computation | year= 1992 | volume= 59 | issue= 199 | pages= 157–163 | doi= 10.2307/2152987 | url= https://pure.tue.nl/ws/files/1670806/353771.pdf }}
